raw:
```sql
SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN "AcceptedAnswerId" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE) / COUNT(*) AS acceptance_rate
FROM main.posts
WHERE "PostTypeId" = 1
  AND "CreaionDate" >= '2013-12-01'
  AND "CreaionDate" < '2014-01-01'
```
